subject: Gender Identity Non-Discrimination Policy ACA-1
overview: The committee reviewed and amended a proposed non-discrimination policy regarding gender identity, focusing on alignment with state regulations and clarifying the rights of students and caregivers. The committee approved several modifications to standardize language and remove redundant sections before referring the matter to the full School Committee.

items.title: Policy ACA-1 Non-Discrimination on the Basis of Gender Identity
items.summary: The committee held a first reading and discussion of the proposed policy, with members raising questions about student privacy, parental notification, and the costs associated with reissuing diplomas.

items.title: Removal of Definitions Section
items.summary: Approved a motion to strike the terminology definitions from the policy and instead maintain an annually updated list on the district website.

items.title: Standardization of Caregiver Terminology
items.summary: Approved a motion to globally replace references to parents and guardians with the standardized term 'caregivers' throughout the document.

items.title: Integration of State Student Record Regulations
items.summary: The committee integrated the full text of state regulation 603 CMR 23.01 to clarify that students gain specific rights over their records upon reaching age 14 or entering ninth grade.

items.title: Amending Student Transition Guidelines
items.summary: Added language stating the district's primary goal is to facilitate the relationship between students and caregivers while maintaining flexibility to protect student safety if a student is not 'out' at home.

items.title: Clarification of Gender Marker Changes
items.summary: Approved updates to the gender marker section to explicitly use the age 14 or ninth grade threshold for student-initiated record changes.

items.title: Removal of Redundant Athletic and Dress Code Sections
items.summary: Approved striking sections regarding athletics and dress codes to avoid policy duplication, as these topics are covered in existing district wellness and dress code policies.

items.title: Referral to Full School Committee
items.summary: Approved a motion to report the amended policy to the full School Committee for a formal reading on November 20th.
